ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels with sparse high-intensity white clusters; estimated white pixel distribution < 5% of visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of uniform dark pigmentation; distinct high-contrast white contiguous clusters are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a symmetric pixel-depth ratio; clearly defined convergence at the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern along the entire continuous boundary; prominent non-uniform indentation on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double convex curve geometry with symmetric upward sweep from the central notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed white pixel clusters forming irregular circular shapes at the extreme distal points of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) scattered across both lobes, with higher concentration on the left lobe's central surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear white scarring and a significant irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced secondary notch/tear on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately mid-way between the central notch and the tip.
